title: 程序员 Vibe Coding 最后十七张
startedAtNote: 本轮长任务开始后记录的内容阶段起点；更早对话与检查耗时不补造。

cards.title: 什么时候值得重构？
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to justify a refactor before changing working code.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 在修改可用代码之前，先说明重构的必要性。
cards.communication_goal: 根据重复逻辑与维护成本判断是否值得重构。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you explain whether a refactor would improve maintainability?
dialogue.zh: 你能解释一下，重构是否会提升可维护性吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Duplicate logic is making every change harder.
dialogue.zh: 可以。重复逻辑让每次修改都变得更困难。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Sketch the proposed structure on this diagram before changing the code.
dialogue.zh: 改代码之前，先在这张图上画出建议的结构。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll compare a small refactor with leaving the code as it is.
dialogue.zh: 我会比较小范围重构与保持现状这两种方案。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.scene_prompt: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left of a small table and points toward one large blank architecture diagram sheet mounted upright at center. The sheet has only three simple unlabeled rectangular boxes connected by plain lines, no letters or numbers. Its complete border is unobstructed. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. No computer screens or extra papers.

words.evidence: 可维护性是代码长期修改难度，不能从静态图形直接判断。

words.example: Can you explain whether a refactor would improve maintainability?
words.translation: 你能解释一下，重构是否会提升可维护性吗？
words.evidence: 这里指调整代码结构的工作，空白示意图不证明重构已经完成。

words.example: Yes. Duplicate logic is making every change harder.

words.evidence: 重复性由代码内容决定，图中不展示可读代码。

words.evidence: 竖立的完整结构示意图纸是可见指代；框整张图纸，不解释其中无文字方框的具体含义。

cards.title: 给 AI 一张参考图怎么说？
cards.description_en: A programmer explains how an AI assistant should use a visual reference without copying it blindly.
cards.description_zh: 程序员说明 AI 应如何使用视觉参考，而不是盲目照搬。
cards.communication_goal: 明确参考图中要借鉴与必须保留的部分。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Use the reference image on this tablet for spacing and visual rhythm.
dialogue.zh: 用这台平板上的参考图来借鉴间距和视觉节奏。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Which parts should I match, and which parts should stay original?
dialogue.zh: 哪些部分需要匹配，哪些部分应该保持原创？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Preserve our layout and use the reference only as guidance.
dialogue.zh: 保留我们的布局，只把参考图当作指导。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll match the spacing without copying its content.
dialogue.zh: 我会匹配间距，但不会复制它的内容。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 加载中，也需要交代
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to show clear feedback while a slow request is loading.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 在慢请求加载期间给出清楚反馈。
cards.communication_goal: 为等待过程提供状态反馈，不制造虚假的完成承诺。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The request takes several seconds. What feedback should we show while it is loading?
dialogue.zh: 这个请求需要几秒钟。加载时应该展示什么反馈？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Show a spinner so people know the page is still working.
dialogue.zh: 显示一个加载转圈，让用户知道页面仍在工作。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can we report progress without promising an exact finish time?
dialogue.zh: 我们能否报告进度，但不承诺精确完成时间？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Keep the spinner visible until the result appears.
dialogue.zh: 可以。结果出现前一直显示加载转圈。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 把空状态和错误状态补齐
cards.description_en: A programmer and an AI assistant design distinct empty and error states for a results panel.
cards.description_zh: 程序员与 AI 为结果面板设计不同的空状态和错误状态。
cards.communication_goal: 补齐异常状态，并为用户提供明确的下一步。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We handled success. What should the empty state explain?
dialogue.zh: 成功状态已经处理了，空状态应该说明什么？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It should say that no results were found and offer a next step.
dialogue.zh: 它应该说明没有找到结果，并提供下一步操作。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This panel also needs an error state when the request fails.
dialogue.zh: 请求失败时，这个面板还需要错误状态。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll design both states and keep their actions distinct.
dialogue.zh: 我会设计这两种状态，并让它们的操作清楚区分。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 从“能点”到“好用”
cards.description_en: A programmer checks whether a working form is also usable from the keyboard.
cards.description_zh: 程序员检查一个能工作的表单是否也能通过键盘顺畅使用。
cards.communication_goal: 从可操作性、焦点顺序和清晰度改进真实使用体验。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The form works with a mouse. Is it usable with this keyboard?
dialogue.zh: 这个表单用鼠标能操作。用这把键盘也好用吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not yet. The focus order is confusing.
dialogue.zh: 还不行。焦点顺序让人困惑。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Make each action obvious and keep the controls easy to reach.
dialogue.zh: 让每个操作都清楚明显，并让控件容易触达。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll improve the keyboard path and test it again.
dialogue.zh: 我会改进键盘操作路径，再测试一次。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 先复现，再动代码
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to reproduce a bug consistently before editing code.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 在修改代码前先稳定复现缺陷。
cards.communication_goal: 先记录复现步骤和环境，再开始修复。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you reproduce the crash on this phone before changing the code?
dialogue.zh: 改代码之前，你能在这部手机上复现崩溃吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not consistently. I need the exact steps and environment.
dialogue.zh: 还不能稳定复现。我需要准确步骤和环境信息。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll repeat each step and record when the crash appears.
dialogue.zh: 我会重复每个步骤，并记录崩溃何时出现。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Once it is consistent, I'll inspect the failing path.
dialogue.zh: 能够稳定复现后，我再检查失败路径。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 把报错和日志一起交给 AI
cards.description_en: A programmer gives an AI assistant both the error and the log from a terminal.
cards.description_zh: 程序员把报错与终端日志一起交给 AI。
cards.communication_goal: 提供完整问题证据，让分析建立在同一上下文上。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll send the error and the log from this terminal.
dialogue.zh: 我会把这个终端里的报错和日志一起发给你。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good. That evidence helps me see when the request failed.
dialogue.zh: 很好。这些证据能帮助我判断请求何时失败。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Compare the request path with the surrounding log entries.
dialogue.zh: 把请求路径与前后的日志条目进行比较。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll use both sources before suggesting a fix.
dialogue.zh: 提出修复建议前，我会同时使用这两份资料。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 最小改动定位根因
cards.description_en: A programmer changes one variable at a time to isolate the root cause of a failure.
cards.description_zh: 程序员一次只改变一个变量，以定位故障根因。
cards.communication_goal: 用最小改动验证假设，避免大范围修改掩盖原因。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Change one condition at a time so we can isolate the failure.
dialogue.zh: 一次只改变一个条件，这样我们才能隔离故障。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Then we can find the root cause without a broad patch.
dialogue.zh: 这样无需大范围补丁也能找到根因。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Use this cable as the only variable in the hardware test.
dialogue.zh: 在硬件测试中，只把这根线缆作为变量。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll keep the patch minimal and compare the result.
dialogue.zh: 我会保持补丁最小，并比较结果。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 卡住时怎样停止无效重试？
cards.description_en: A programmer stops repeated failed attempts and asks an AI assistant to escalate with evidence.
cards.description_zh: 程序员停止反复失败的尝试，让 AI 带着证据升级处理。
cards.communication_goal: 在不确定时停止无效重试，整理证据并交回决策。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We have tried the same fix three times. Do not retry it again.
dialogue.zh: 同一个修复已经试了三次，不要再重试。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm still uncertain about the root cause.
dialogue.zh: 我仍然不确定根因。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Put the evidence on this clipboard and escalate the decision to me.
dialogue.zh: 把证据整理到这块写字夹板上，并把决定升级交给我。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll stop here and wait for your direction.
dialogue.zh: 我会停在这里，等待你的指示。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 测试通过，还漏了什么？
cards.description_en: A programmer asks what test coverage is still missing after the main checks pass.

cards.communication_goal: 补充异常场景与隐含假设，不把测试通过等同于全部正确。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The main tests passed. What coverage is still missing?
dialogue.zh: 主要测试通过了。还缺少哪些覆盖？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: We have not checked the offline scenario or the timeout.
dialogue.zh: 我们还没有检查离线场景和超时。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Add each assumption and missing scenario to this checklist.
dialogue.zh: 把每个假设和缺失场景都加到这份检查清单里。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll test those cases before calling the feature complete.
dialogue.zh: 在宣布功能完成前，我会测试这些情况。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 审查代码时先看哪几处？
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to inspect risky boundaries and failure paths first.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 优先检查高风险边界与失败路径。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Inspect the risky boundary and failure path before reviewing style.
dialogue.zh: 先检查高风险边界和失败路径，再看代码风格。

dialogue.en: Should I start with input validation and permission checks?

dialogue.speaker: B

cards.title: 让 AI 解释安全与性能取舍
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to explain a security and performance trade-off.

cards.communication_goal: 把收益、代价与适用条件说清楚，再由人作决定。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Explain the trade-off between security and performance.
dialogue.zh: 解释一下安全性与性能之间的取舍。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Stronger checks improve security but add work to every request.
dialogue.zh: 更严格的检查会提升安全性，但也会增加每个请求的处理工作。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Use this balance scale to compare both costs clearly.
dialogue.zh: 用这架天平把两边的代价比较清楚。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll describe the performance cost and when the security benefit matters.
dialogue.zh: 我会说明性能代价，以及安全收益在什么情况下重要。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

dialogue.en: I'll separate confirmed results from open questions in the report.

cards.title: 让每次提交都能说清楚

words.evidence: 这里是版本控制提交，不把文件夹或放置动作当作提交完成证据。

words.example: Keep this commit atomic and give it a clear message.
words.translation: 让这次提交保持原子化，并写一条清楚的提交信息。
words.evidence: 提交信息应为文字，但底图禁止可读文字，因此只由对白教学。

words.example: Keep this commit atomic and give it a clear message.
words.translation: 让这次提交保持原子化，并写一条清楚的提交信息。
words.evidence: 原子化指一次提交只含一个意图，与物理原子或文件夹大小无关。

words.example: No. Leave those files in this folder for a separate commit.
words.translation: 不要。把那些文件留在这个文件夹里，另做一次提交。
words.evidence: 桌面上完整打开的实体文件夹及其标签页是直接指代，只框文件夹。

cards.title: 发布之前先准备回滚
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to prepare a rollback before a release.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 在发布前准备回滚方案。
cards.communication_goal: 发布前保留可恢复版本，并明确回退触发条件与步骤。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Before the release, prepare a rollback plan.
dialogue.zh: 发布之前，先准备回滚方案。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll keep the previous package as a backup.
dialogue.zh: 我会把上一个软件包保留为备份。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Place the tested package in this box and record the restore steps.
dialogue.zh: 把测试过的软件包放进这个盒子，并记录恢复步骤。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Then the rollback can start quickly if the health check fails.
dialogue.zh: 这样如果健康检查失败，我们就能快速回滚。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 第一位用户说不好用怎么办？
cards.description_en: A programmer asks how to respond when the first user gives negative feedback.
cards.description_zh: 第一位用户给出负面反馈后，程序员询问该如何回应。
cards.communication_goal: 先倾听、观察和澄清真实阻碍，再做最小改进。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Our first user says the flow feels awkward. How should we handle the feedback?
dialogue.zh: 第一位用户说流程很别扭。我们该如何处理这条反馈？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Ask what they tried and observe where they hesitate.
dialogue.zh: 问清他们尝试了什么，并观察他们在哪里犹豫。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll use this headset to clarify the problem without defending the design.
dialogue.zh: 我会用这个耳麦澄清问题，而不是急着为设计辩护。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Then we'll change the smallest part that blocks them.
dialogue.zh: 然后我们只改真正阻碍他们的最小部分。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 从一次成功到可重复交付
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to turn one successful release into a repeatable delivery process.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 把一次成功发布变成可重复的交付流程。
cards.communication_goal: 固定稳定步骤、人工检查与恢复入口，使他人也能重复执行。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The release worked once. How do we make the delivery repeatable?
dialogue.zh: 这次发布成功了。怎样让交付过程可以重复？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Automate the stable steps and write a procedure for the manual checks.
dialogue.zh: 把稳定步骤自动化，并为人工检查写一份流程。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Put the sequence in this template so another person can follow it.
dialogue.zh: 把步骤顺序写进这个模板，让其他人也能照着执行。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Then we'll run the procedure again from a clean environment.
dialogue.zh: 然后我们会在干净环境中再次执行这套流程。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

words.example: Automate the stable steps and write a procedure for the manual checks.
